Q: What is the professional approach to appearance and attire
Option1: Match required attire for the customer environment
Option3: Wear a suit in all cases

Q: Best way to start information gathering
Option1: Begin with open ended questions then narrow with focused questions
Option2: Ask only yes or no questions

Q: Why avoid jargon acronyms and slang
Option1: They confuse customers and reduce trust

Q: What is active listening
Option1: Focus take notes restate the issue and avoid interrupting

Q: What should you do if you will be late
Option1: Contact the customer and update the timeline

Q: Best response to a difficult customer
Option1: Stay calm avoid arguing and restate the problem for clarity

Q: What is the correct action when private files are visible on a desktop
Option1: Do not read them and protect confidentiality

Q: Why provide clear status updates
Option1: Set expectations and reduce uncertainty

Q: When a device is not economical to repair
Option1: Offer repair or replacement options per policy and get approval

Q: What is the best tone to use
Option1: Positive and respectful

Q: Where should you record actions and findings
Option1: In the ticket or work order

Q: Which behavior shows cultural sensitivity
Option1: Use appropriate titles and respect local customs
Option2: Assume all people share your customs

Q: What should you do with distractions like personal calls
Option1: Silence them and focus on the customer

Q: What is the goal of a closeout summary
Option1: Confirm work performed next steps and contact path

Q: How should you respond when you do not know an answer
Option1: Be honest and say you will find out and follow up

Q: What is a professional way to address user names
Option1: Use the customers preferred name and title

Q: Which note style is best
Option1: Clear objective notes with steps and results

Q: What is the correct data handling during a repair
Option1: Access only data needed with permission and protect privacy

Q: During triage which issue should be handled first
Option1: Safety or data loss risk then service impact then minor issues

Q: If a customer asks for an off policy action what should you do
Option1: Explain the policy and offer approved alternatives
